jobs.title: VP, Surety Solutions
jobs.description:
Join US as a VP, Surety Solutions

Who We Are

Tokio Marine Canada (TMCan) is a Canadian early-stage entrepreneurial commercial P&C insurer based in Toronto. We partner with select brokers to deliver tailored business insurance solutions across Canada. As part of the Tokio Marine Group, we are able to collaborate under a shared framework while maintaining autonomy and local decision-making.

We support Canadian businesses in taking smart risks by delivering practical insurance solutions and exceptional service through trusted broker partnerships.

The Opportunity

Working closely with business leaders and your peers, we are looking for a VP, Surety Solutions. You will be instrumental in leading and building out the surety business in Ontario and Atlantic Canada, through working collaboratively with the Tokio Marine Canada Surety unit. Our focus is simple - create the best team of professionals in the business. If you enjoy the excitement, challenges and rewards that come with creating better ways to do business, this may be the opportunity for you.

What You Will Be Doing

Strategy, Broker Management and Brand promotion

Partner closely with the Senior Vice President and the Surety Leadership Group to develop and execute the strategic direction for Ontario and Atlantic Canada, aligned with national surety priorities.
Help lead the day-to-day surety operations for Ontario and Atlantic Canada, promoting consistent underwriting practices, strong execution, accountability and effective communication across the team.
Provide leadership, analysis, and insight for the Ontario and Atlantic Canada regions by monitoring the competitive landscape, optimizing risk selection, and enhancing the company's competitive position.
Ownership over budgeting, identifying critical success factors and ensuring goals are being met.
Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of overall line of business performance through analysis of reports while taking strategic actions to improve results.
Proactively work with broker partners to strengthen relationships and ensure business plans are met.
Build and manage select broker relationships.
Working closely with surety team in building and implementing broker strategy.
Promoting the Tokio Marine Canada brand, working closely with various business units including Commercial Insurance and ProFin.
Travel to various regions on a regular basis. Participate in various broker and industry events as required.

Underwriting

Evaluate new risks through thorough analysis to determine acceptability and pricing.
Analyze financial statements, capacity, collateral and character of new surety opportunities.
Analyze and review projects, approving within given authority, or recommending approval or denial of surety bonds.
Conducting ongoing review and management of surety portfolio, ensuring accounts information is current with action items being followed up.
Work with surety team in creating and improving systems and processes, with focus on continued efficiencies.
Help assist underwriting efforts and decision making across country where needed.
Support marketing, legal and claims services when required.
Working closely and collaboratively with Surety Team across Canada.

People Leadership

Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performance culture by building trust, encouraging open dialogue and working effectively within the surety team.
Lead and mentor younger underwriter(s) to ensure continuous professional development and high performance.
Perform ongoing talent management, including hiring, mentoring, training, performance management, and recognition.

Who You Are

You are an experienced Surety leader. You are a team player with a positive attitude who thrives in a consensus culture with an emphasis on collaboration. You are a self-starter who is excited by the opportunity to jump right in and can come up to speed quickly. You are comfortable working on a lean team and are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and do the work that needs to be done.

What You Bring

University Bachelor’s Degree, Business or related preferred.
Minimum 10 years of experience in Surety, with direct people leader experience
Strong leadership skills to motivate, develop, and manage performance for results.
Strong financial acumen and the ability to use data to drive decision-making.
Extensive understanding of business, underwriting, and corporate risk management and mitigation methods.
The ability to partner with our staff within different lines of business.
A high level of organizational skills and attention to detail.
A proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines, driving for results.
Thought leadership and can innovate solutions quickly.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience working closely with others and enjoy an atmosphere of cross-collaboration.
The ability to thrive in a fast paced and changing environment and be comfortable with ambiguity.
Superb customer service skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Teams, and Outlook).
Bilingual (English/French) preferred but not required.

This posting is for an existing vacancy at Tokio Marine Canada. We are actively hiring for this position and encourage qualified candidates to apply.

Tokio Marine Canada may use AI tools during the recruitment process to assist with screening, assessment or selection of applicants for a position.

Life at Tokio Marine Canada

At TMCan, we’re a relationship company. We value collaboration, innovation, and inclusion, where every voice matters and every team member makes an impact. We believe in flexibility, authenticity, and growth: because when our people thrive, so does our business. TMCan offers the unique opportunity to work side by side with senior leaders, gaining direct exposure to strategic decision-making and business planning.

Our CARE Values Guide Everything We Do

Collaborative:
We communicate openly, support one another, and work as one team.

Achieving Excellence:
We challenge the status quo and exceed expectations.

Responsive:
We anticipate needs and deliver timely, exceptional service.

Ethical & Respectful:
We act with integrity and empower our people to do the right thing.

Our Commitment to an Inclusive and Respectful Workplace

At TMCan, we are deeply committed to fostering a culture of equity, diversity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every individual is welcomed, respected, and valued for their unique identity and perspective. By embracing our differences and learning from one another, we aim to build a positive and empowering environment for all.

Tokio Marine Canada was proudly recognized as one of the Best Places to Work in Canada by Canadian HR Reporter in 2024.

We work in a hybrid model, and you should expect to split your time between working in the office and working remotely, with flexibility based on the role and the business needs. We currently have an office in downtown Toronto and will eventually be establishing offices in other provinces. Should you currently work in a province where we do not have an office, you will remain remote until such time as we do establish an office.

Tokio Marine Canada is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if TMCan hires that candidate.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

The Director / GM, Global Marketing & Sales Enablement
is responsible for defining and driving Husky's global brand strategy, leading B2B marketing and demand generation, advancing sustainability advocacy and industry engagement, delivering actionable market intelligence, and improving global sales effectiveness.

Reporting to the EVP, Sales & Marketing, this leader will strengthen Husky's market position and industry influence, build an integrated commercial support function, and connect market insights, customer engagement, and sales capabilities to deliver measurable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Global Brand Strategy, Marketing & Industry Advocacy
Own Husky's global brand strategy, positioning, identity, and differentiation, ensuring a compelling and consistent presence across markets and customer touchpoints.
Develop and execute global B2B marketing programs that generate qualified leads and commercial opportunities through digital channels, integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, trade shows, and customer events.
Lead Husky's sustainability advocacy and industry engagement strategy, partnering with industry associations, customers, and value-chain stakeholders to advance science-based understanding of plastics, address misconceptions, and promote responsible use, recycling, and circularity.
Represent Husky's perspectives in relevant industry initiatives and advocacy programs, strengthening its reputation as a credible technology leader and constructive voice in sustainability discussions.
Establish metrics to evaluate brand strength, marketing contribution to pipeline, and the reach and effectiveness of advocacy initiatives.
Market Intelligence & Strategic Insights
Lead a centralized market intelligence and research capability serving Sales, Product Line Management, Strategy, Investor Relations, and executive leadership.
Deliver actionable insights on market trends, competitive dynamics, customer needs, sustainability-related market developments, and emerging growth opportunities.
Support strategic planning, market prioritization, product portfolio decisions, and commercial growth initiatives.
Establish systematic approaches to market research, competitive intelligence, and voice-of-customer analysis.
Strategic Customer Engagement & Sales Enablement
Lead the development of executive-level content and strategic narratives for Top-to-Top (T2T) customer meetings, supporting senior leadership and strategic account engagement.
Develop high-impact sales enablement content, including value propositions, product and solution presentations, competitive positioning, case studies, and customer value tools.
Partner with Sales, Product Line Management, and Engineering to ensure differentiated, consistent, and customer-focused messaging.
Equip global commercial teams with the content, knowledge, and capabilities required to engage customers effectively and win business.
Sales Effectiveness & Commercial Excellence
Partner with Sales leadership to improve sales productivity, commercial processes, opportunity management, and overall sales effectiveness.
Drive adoption of sales methodologies, CRM capabilities, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to strengthen commercial execution.
Develop scalable approaches to sales training, onboarding, best-practice sharing, and continuous improvement of capability.
Establish performance metrics and improvement initiatives focused on sales efficiency, conversion rates, win rates, and commercial productivity.

Leadership & Experience

The successful candidate will be a strategic, commercially oriented leader with proven experience in global brand management, complex industrial B2B marketing, market intelligence, and sales enablement.

Experience engaging industry associations, building external partnerships, and shaping industry narratives around sustainability, circularity, or related topics is highly desirable.

The role requires strong business acumen, the ability to lead global multidisciplinary teams, and the credibility to influence executive stakeholders while translating market insights and brand strategy into measurable commercial outcomes.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or other advanced business degree considered an asset
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in global B2B marketing, brand strategy, commercial excellence, or sales enablement within a complex industrial, manufacturing, technology, or capital equipment environment
Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive brand growth, lead generation, customer engagement, and measurable commercial results across global markets.
Proven experience leveraging market intelligence, competitive insights, and voice-of-customer research to influence business strategy, portfolio decisions, and growth initiatives.
Strong track record leading cross-functional and global teams, influencing executive stakeholders, and driving adoption of sales methodologies, CRM platforms, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to improve sales effectiveness.

Vacancy: Replacement

Pay Range: $150,000.00 - 185,000.00

jobs.description:

Our Purpose

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

Have many careers in one Firm.
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

--

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

What will your typical day look like?

Deloitte Global is seeking an experienced technology leader to lead the strategy, architecture, delivery, and continued evolution of our enterprise Salesforce platform and solutions.

As the Director, Salesforce Delivery & Architecture
, you will set the technical and delivery direction for Salesforce, translate business priorities into a scalable platform roadmap, and lead global teams across architecture, engineering, delivery, and operations. You will partner closely with senior business, product, and technology leaders and serve as a trusted advisor on platform strategy, investment, innovation, and execution.

This role combines Salesforce platform leadership, enterprise architecture, global delivery, governance, and technology strategy
and is ideal for a leader who can connect technical decisions to measurable business outcomes.

Work You'll Do

Define and lead the Salesforce platform strategy, architecture, and multi-year technology roadmap, aligning investments and capabilities with business and technology priorities.
Provide technical and delivery leadership across Salesforce solutions, integrations, and related enterprise platforms.
Lead global delivery teams through solution architecture, engineering, implementation, release, operations, and continuous improvement.
Establish architecture principles, engineering standards, and technical decision-making practices that enable scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable solutions.
Partner with business sponsors, product owners, architects, and engineering teams to translate business priorities into platform capabilities and delivery plans.
Lead demand management, prioritization, and roadmap decisions across the Salesforce portfolio.
Provide leadership for major Salesforce implementations, enhancements, modernization efforts, and platform lifecycle initiatives.
Guide integration strategy across Salesforce and enterprise applications, including APIs, middleware, data platforms, and cloud services.
Champion Agile delivery, DevOps, and CI/CD practices to improve delivery speed, platform quality, reliability, and performance.
Evaluate emerging Salesforce capabilities, including Agentforce and AI-enabled solutions, and identify opportunities to apply them responsibly to business needs.
Define and track KPIs that measure platform performance, delivery outcomes, investment value, and value realization.
Lead technology budgeting, forecasting, resource planning, vendor management, and strategic technology partnerships.
Identify and manage technical, operational, financial, and delivery risks and ensure appropriate governance and mitigation plans are maintained.
Build trusted-advisor relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders while fostering collaboration across global teams.

Coach and develop technology leaders and promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaborartion, and continuous improvement.

About The Team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in "what is" but rather "what can be" to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

Required

Enough about us, let’s talk about you

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
15+ years of progressive technology experience, including significant leadership responsibility for enterprise technology platforms, applications, or solutions.
8+ years of Salesforce platform, architecture, or delivery experience, including leadership of complex enterprise implementations or transformation programs.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale technology initiatives from strategy and architecture through implementation and ongoing operations.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, integration patterns, APIs, data architecture, and modern application delivery.
Experience working with business sponsors, product owners, architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions.
Experience leading globally distributed teams and working effectively across employees, contractors, vendors, and strategic technology partners.
Strong knowledge of Agile delivery and contemporary software development lifecycle practices.
Demonstrated experience with financial management, technology investment planning, vendor management, and resource planning.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear business decisions.

Preferred

Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or other enterprise Salesforce products.
Experience with MuleSoft or comparable enterprise integration technologies.
Experience with modern Salesforce DevOps and CI/CD practices.
Knowledge of Salesforce Agentforce, AI-enabled Salesforce capabilities, or enterprise AI integration.
Salesforce architecture or advanced platform certification(s).
Experience supporting a large, complex, global enterprise.
Experience within professional services or financial services.
Experience establishing enterprise architecture standards, platform governance, and long-term technology roadmaps.

Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $140,000 - $260,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life.

Be yourself, and more.

We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.

You Shape How We Make Impact.

Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute.

Be the leader you want to be

Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.

Have as many careers as you want.

We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors.

The next step is yours

At Deloitte, we are all about doing business inclusively – that starts with having diverse colleagues of all abilities. Deloitte encourages applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of communities across Canada. This includes, but is not limited to, people with disabilities, candidates from Indigenous communities, and candidates from the Black community in support of living our values, creating a culture of Diversity Equity and Inclusion and our commitment to our AccessAbility Action Plan, Reconciliation Action Plan and the BlackNorth Initiative.

We encourage you to connect with us at accessiblecareers@deloitte.ca if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations) or indigenouscareers@deloitte.ca for any questions relating to careers for Indigenous peoples at Deloitte (First Nations, Inuit, Métis).

When you apply, we will review your application using Deloitte's Global Talent Standards to ensure a consistent recruitment experience. Our recruitment advisors and hiring teams will utilize human screening combined with AI technology to help identify the skills and qualities that matter most to our business, while safeguarding your privacy and using AI responsibly.

Deloitte Canada has 20 offices with representation across most of the country. We acknowledge that Deloitte offices stand on traditional, treaty, and unceded territories in what is now known as Canada. We recognize that Indigenous Peoples have been the caretakers of this land since time immemorial, nurturing its resources and preserving its natural beauty. We acknowledge this land is still home to many First Nations, Inuit, and Métis Peoples, who continue to maintain their deep connection to the land and its sacred teachings. We humbly acknowledge that we are all Treaty people, and we commit to fostering a relationship of respect, collaboration, and stewardship with Indigenous communities in our shared goal of reconciliation and environmental sustainability.

Reporting to the EVP, Sales & Marketing, this leader will strengthen Husky's market position and industry influence, build an integrated commercial support function, and connect market insights, customer engagement, and sales capabilities to deliver measurable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Global Brand Strategy, Marketing & Industry Advocacy
Own Husky's global brand strategy, positioning, identity, and differentiation, ensuring a compelling and consistent presence across markets and customer touchpoints.
Develop and execute global B2B marketing programs that generate qualified leads and commercial opportunities through digital channels, integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, trade shows, and customer events.
Lead Husky's sustainability advocacy and industry engagement strategy, partnering with industry associations, customers, and value-chain stakeholders to advance science-based understanding of plastics, address misconceptions, and promote responsible use, recycling, and circularity.
Represent Husky's perspectives in relevant industry initiatives and advocacy programs, strengthening its reputation as a credible technology leader and constructive voice in sustainability discussions.
Establish metrics to evaluate brand strength, marketing contribution to pipeline, and the reach and effectiveness of advocacy initiatives.
Market Intelligence & Strategic Insights
Lead a centralized market intelligence and research capability serving Sales, Product Line Management, Strategy, Investor Relations, and executive leadership.
Deliver actionable insights on market trends, competitive dynamics, customer needs, sustainability-related market developments, and emerging growth opportunities.
Support strategic planning, market prioritization, product portfolio decisions, and commercial growth initiatives.
Establish systematic approaches to market research, competitive intelligence, and voice-of-customer analysis.
Strategic Customer Engagement & Sales Enablement
Lead the development of executive-level content and strategic narratives for Top-to-Top (T2T) customer meetings, supporting senior leadership and strategic account engagement.
Develop high-impact sales enablement content, including value propositions, product and solution presentations, competitive positioning, case studies, and customer value tools.
Partner with Sales, Product Line Management, and Engineering to ensure differentiated, consistent, and customer-focused messaging.
Equip global commercial teams with the content, knowledge, and capabilities required to engage customers effectively and win business.
Sales Effectiveness & Commercial Excellence
Partner with Sales leadership to improve sales productivity, commercial processes, opportunity management, and overall sales effectiveness.
Drive adoption of sales methodologies, CRM capabilities, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to strengthen commercial execution.
Develop scalable approaches to sales training, onboarding, best-practice sharing, and continuous improvement of capability.
Establish performance metrics and improvement initiatives focused on sales efficiency, conversion rates, win rates, and commercial productivity.

Leadership & Experience

The successful candidate will be a strategic, commercially oriented leader with proven experience in global brand management, complex industrial B2B marketing, market intelligence, and sales enablement.

Experience engaging industry associations, building external partnerships, and shaping industry narratives around sustainability, circularity, or related topics is highly desirable.

The role requires strong business acumen, the ability to lead global multidisciplinary teams, and the credibility to influence executive stakeholders while translating market insights and brand strategy into measurable commercial outcomes.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or other advanced business degree considered an asset
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in global B2B marketing, brand strategy, commercial excellence, or sales enablement within a complex industrial, manufacturing, technology, or capital equipment environment
Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive brand growth, lead generation, customer engagement, and measurable commercial results across global markets.
Proven experience leveraging market intelligence, competitive insights, and voice-of-customer research to influence business strategy, portfolio decisions, and growth initiatives.
Strong track record leading cross-functional and global teams, influencing executive stakeholders, and driving adoption of sales methodologies, CRM platforms, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to improve sales effectiveness.

Vacancy: Replacement

Pay Range: $150,000.00 - 185,000.00

Our Purpose

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

Have many careers in one Firm.
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

--

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

What will your typical day look like?

Deloitte Global is seeking an experienced technology leader to lead the strategy, architecture, delivery, and continued evolution of our enterprise Salesforce platform and solutions.

As the Director, Salesforce Delivery & Architecture
, you will set the technical and delivery direction for Salesforce, translate business priorities into a scalable platform roadmap, and lead global teams across architecture, engineering, delivery, and operations. You will partner closely with senior business, product, and technology leaders and serve as a trusted advisor on platform strategy, investment, innovation, and execution.

This role combines Salesforce platform leadership, enterprise architecture, global delivery, governance, and technology strategy
and is ideal for a leader who can connect technical decisions to measurable business outcomes.

Work You'll Do

Define and lead the Salesforce platform strategy, architecture, and multi-year technology roadmap, aligning investments and capabilities with business and technology priorities.
Provide technical and delivery leadership across Salesforce solutions, integrations, and related enterprise platforms.
Lead global delivery teams through solution architecture, engineering, implementation, release, operations, and continuous improvement.
Establish architecture principles, engineering standards, and technical decision-making practices that enable scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable solutions.
Partner with business sponsors, product owners, architects, and engineering teams to translate business priorities into platform capabilities and delivery plans.
Lead demand management, prioritization, and roadmap decisions across the Salesforce portfolio.
Provide leadership for major Salesforce implementations, enhancements, modernization efforts, and platform lifecycle initiatives.
Guide integration strategy across Salesforce and enterprise applications, including APIs, middleware, data platforms, and cloud services.
Champion Agile delivery, DevOps, and CI/CD practices to improve delivery speed, platform quality, reliability, and performance.
Evaluate emerging Salesforce capabilities, including Agentforce and AI-enabled solutions, and identify opportunities to apply them responsibly to business needs.
Define and track KPIs that measure platform performance, delivery outcomes, investment value, and value realization.
Lead technology budgeting, forecasting, resource planning, vendor management, and strategic technology partnerships.
Identify and manage technical, operational, financial, and delivery risks and ensure appropriate governance and mitigation plans are maintained.
Build trusted-advisor relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders while fostering collaboration across global teams.

Coach and develop technology leaders and promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaborartion, and continuous improvement.

About The Team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in "what is" but rather "what can be" to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

Required

Enough about us, let’s talk about you

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
15+ years of progressive technology experience, including significant leadership responsibility for enterprise technology platforms, applications, or solutions.
8+ years of Salesforce platform, architecture, or delivery experience, including leadership of complex enterprise implementations or transformation programs.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale technology initiatives from strategy and architecture through implementation and ongoing operations.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, integration patterns, APIs, data architecture, and modern application delivery.
Experience working with business sponsors, product owners, architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions.
Experience leading globally distributed teams and working effectively across employees, contractors, vendors, and strategic technology partners.
Strong knowledge of Agile delivery and contemporary software development lifecycle practices.
Demonstrated experience with financial management, technology investment planning, vendor management, and resource planning.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear business decisions.

Preferred

Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or other enterprise Salesforce products.
Experience with MuleSoft or comparable enterprise integration technologies.
Experience with modern Salesforce DevOps and CI/CD practices.
Knowledge of Salesforce Agentforce, AI-enabled Salesforce capabilities, or enterprise AI integration.
Salesforce architecture or advanced platform certification(s).
Experience supporting a large, complex, global enterprise.
Experience within professional services or financial services.
Experience establishing enterprise architecture standards, platform governance, and long-term technology roadmaps.

Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $140,000 - $260,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life.

Be yourself, and more.

We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.

You Shape How We Make Impact.

Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute.

Be the leader you want to be

Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.

Have as many careers as you want.

We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors.

The next step is yours

At Deloitte, we are all about doing business inclusively – that starts with having diverse colleagues of all abilities. Deloitte encourages applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of communities across Canada. This includes, but is not limited to, people with disabilities, candidates from Indigenous communities, and candidates from the Black community in support of living our values, creating a culture of Diversity Equity and Inclusion and our commitment to our AccessAbility Action Plan, Reconciliation Action Plan and the BlackNorth Initiative.

We encourage you to connect with us at accessiblecareers@deloitte.ca if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations) or indigenouscareers@deloitte.ca for any questions relating to careers for Indigenous peoples at Deloitte (First Nations, Inuit, Métis).

When you apply, we will review your application using Deloitte's Global Talent Standards to ensure a consistent recruitment experience. Our recruitment advisors and hiring teams will utilize human screening combined with AI technology to help identify the skills and qualities that matter most to our business, while safeguarding your privacy and using AI responsibly.

Deloitte Canada has 20 offices with representation across most of the country. We acknowledge that Deloitte offices stand on traditional, treaty, and unceded territories in what is now known as Canada. We recognize that Indigenous Peoples have been the caretakers of this land since time immemorial, nurturing its resources and preserving its natural beauty. We acknowledge this land is still home to many First Nations, Inuit, and Métis Peoples, who continue to maintain their deep connection to the land and its sacred teachings. We humbly acknowledge that we are all Treaty people, and we commit to fostering a relationship of respect, collaboration, and stewardship with Indigenous communities in our shared goal of reconciliation and environmental sustainability.
